Centering gives Cov(x,y)=Sigma_x A^T (DxE), reverse covariance A Sigma_x (ExD). Current pitfall correctly distinguishes input/noise independence from diagonality of Q.
p6:main.derivation: Let δx=x-μx. Since μy=Aμx+b, δy=Aδx+w. Then Cov(x,y)=E[δx(Aδx+w)ᵀ]=ΣxAᵀ+E[δxwᵀ]. Independence and zero means make the last term zero. Transposing yields Cov(y,x)=AΣx.
p6:main.checks: Shapes D×E and E×D, respectively; they are transposes, not generally equal. Diagonality of Q is unnecessary for this result.
p6:main.comparison_condition: Centering gives Cov(x,y)=Sigma_x A^T (DxE), reverse covariance A Sigma_x (ExD). Current pitfall correctly distinguishes input/noise independence from diagonality of Q.
